p: Tartan came to: Who was captain of Sennacherib, 2Ki 18:17.
Ashdod: A city of the Philistines.
Sargon the king of Assyria sent: The Hebrews write that Sennacherib was so called.
sackcloth from off thy loins: Which signifies that the prophet lamented the misery that he saw prepared before the three years that he went naked and barefooted.
Cush their expectation: In whose aid they trusted.
glory: Of whom they boasted and gloried.
isle shall say in that day: Meaning Judea which was encompassed by their enemies as an isle with waters.
